definitions.measured_grid_demand_mwh: EA reconciled offtake; excludes behind-meter self-consumption
definitions.reconciled_injection_mwh: EA reconciled injection; authoritative national supply-side accounting total
definitions.unmapped_generation_residual_mwh: reconciled injection minus Generation_MD mapped generation
definitions.underlying_consumption_mwh: measured grid demand plus modelled behind-meter retained residential solar

btm_estimate.method: Monthly installed residential solar capacity, linearly averaged between month-end observations, multiplied by scenario-specific annual PV yield.

accounting.yield_low: Anchored by an anonymised Northland residential 13.5 kWp system with shading/non-ideal orientation that generated about 13.5 MWh in calendar 2025.
accounting.yield_central: Fleet-average starting assumption below observed Northland tracker-farm yields, allowing for fixed roofs, mixed orientation, shading and residential losses.
accounting.yield_high: Upper residential fleet case, still materially below observed tracker-farm specific yield.
accounting.retention: Fraction of gross residential PV generation retained behind the meter as direct load or battery charging. Export is the remainder. The anonymised Northland PV+battery case retained about 51% of PV before storage losses in 2025.
accounting.battery_export: Assumed zero by default. Explicit VPP/battery export scenarios can be added later.
accounting.accounting: Only retained behind-meter PV is added back to reconciled offtake when estimating underlying end-use electricity consumption. Exported PV is not added because it is visible to the network/reconciliation system.

distributed_solar.battery_export_assumption: zero by default except explicit VPP/export scenarios
